question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** "longevity."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word "longevity" means long life; the fact of lasting a long time. (लंबा जीवन; दीर्घ आयु)

 
 
• Example: *Elephants are known for their **longevity**__.*

 
 
 
 
 
• The sentence conveys that textures that are exposed to both natural and ultra violet light may not last as long.
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct paragraph: 

One of the greatest __threats__ to textiles is light. It is a form of energy that can fade colour and cause chemical and physical __degradation__ of textile fibres. Exposure to both, natural and ultra violet light can threaten the __longevity__ of textiles. Light damage occurs progressively. You must have noticed at home that the most faded folds of curtains are the first to ______ (4) ______ and fall apart. Fading of colours and alterations of hues are the ______ (5) ______ easy-to-detect signs of light damage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Seniority: **the position or importance that a person has in a company, organization, etc. in relation to others. (किसी कंपनी, संस्‍था आदि में किसी व्यक्ति का पद या महत्व (दूसरों की तुलना में), किसी व्यक्ति की वरिष्‍ठता; सीनियॉरिटी)
 
• **Oldness: **the quality of being old. (बूढ़ा होने का गुण)
 
• **Dexterity: **skill at doing things, especially with your hands. (दक्षता, निपुणता (विशेषतः हाथ के काम में))
